176.name: grow
176.docs: Share of free main-axis space this box takes inside its parent stack.

327.name: LayoutTree
327.docs: A layout tree whose measured leaves carry a context `C`.

225.name: limit
225.docs: The width to wrap at, if any.

325.name: fit
325.docs: Nodes whose `align_self` is [`Align::Fit`], until their parent is known.

224.name: Available
224.docs: Space offered to a measured leaf along one axis.

223.name: MaxContent
223.docs: Lay out without constraints (e.g. never wrap).

172.name: height
172.docs: Fixed height in logical pixels; `None` sizes to content.

222.name: MinContent
222.docs: Lay out as narrow as possible (e.g. wrap at every opportunity).

171.name: width
171.docs: Fixed width in logical pixels; `None` sizes to content.

221.name: Definite
221.docs: A definite number of logical pixels.

93.name: Align
93.docs: Cross-axis alignment of a stack's children.

92.name: Fit
92.docs:
As `align_self`: keep its own size. It follows a parent that centers or
ends its children, and goes to the start of one that stretches them.
This is what a button wants, so it never grows to a column's width.

292.name: LayoutError
292.docs: A failure reported by the underlying Taffy tree, e.g. an unknown node id.

166.name: spacing
166.docs: Gap between consecutive children, in logical pixels.

90.name: End
90.docs: Align to the trailing edge of the cross axis.

165.name: axis
165.docs: Stack direction, or `None` for a leaf.

340.name: node_count
340.docs: Total number of nodes in the tree.

365.name: ravenrs_layout
365.docs:
Layout for RavenRS, built on [Taffy](https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy).

Widgets describe boxes with [`LayoutStyle`] (a deliberately small subset of
flexbox: stacks, gaps, padding, alignment, sizes and growth). Leaves that size
themselves, such as text, carry a context `C` and are measured through a
callback, so this crate does not depend on the text engine.

88.name: Start
88.docs: Align to the leading edge of the cross axis.

339.name: context_mut
339.docs: Mutable access to a measured leaf's context, or `None` for nodes without one.

338.name: content_size
338.docs: The size of the node's content, which can exceed its frame when it overflows.

337.name: content_box
337.docs: The content box (frame minus padding) relative to the node's own origin.

185.name: leaf
185.docs: A leaf box with no children and default sizing.

260.name: MeasureInput
260.docs: What a measured leaf is asked.

33.name: into
33.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

184.name: stack
184.docs: A stack along `axis` with default spacing, padding and alignment.

335.name: frame
335.docs: The node's frame relative to its parent's origin.

259.name: available_height
259.docs: Vertical space offered by the parent.

183.name: LayoutStyle
183.docs: The box model a widget asks for. `axis: None` makes a leaf.

258.name: available_width
258.docs: Horizontal space offered by the parent.

182.name: absolute
182.docs:
Takes the box out of the flow and places it at this `(x, y)` offset
from its parent's top-left corner (design surfaces, diagrams, canvases).

257.name: known_height
257.docs: Height already fixed by the parent, if any.

131.name: Justify
131.docs: Main-axis distribution of a stack's children.

181.name: aspect_ratio
181.docs: Width divided by height; with one dimension known, the other follows.

332.name: measured_leaf
332.docs: Adds a leaf whose size comes from the measure callback given to [`Self::compute`].

256.name: known_width
256.docs: Dimensions already fixed by the parent.

130.name: SpaceBetween
130.docs: Put free space evenly between children, none at the ends.

4.name: Axis
4.docs: Direction in which a stack places its children.

180.name: wrap
180.docs: Children move to a new line when they do not fit (flex-wrap).

331.name: compute
331.docs: Computes the layout of `root` inside `available` logical pixels.

129.name: End
129.docs: Pack children at the end of the main axis.

179.name: grid_columns
179.docs: Lays children out in this many equal-width grid columns instead of a stack.

330.name: node
330.docs: Adds a container (or a fixed-size leaf) with the given children.

128.name: Center
128.docs: Center children on the main axis.

178.name: overflow_hidden
178.docs:
Content may overflow this box (it scrolls or clips): the box does not
grow to fit its content.

329.name: clear
329.docs: Removes every node, keeping allocations for the next build.

127.name: Start
127.docs: Pack children at the start of the main axis.

177.name: align_self
177.docs: Overrides the parent's cross-axis alignment for this box.
